name: Revenant

rounds.endCondition: Scoring happens after the Skirmish phase of Cycle 4

categories.label: Colony card
categories.hint: Prestige printed on the chosen Colony card (0 if none selected). Shared, but each player scores it.

categories.label: House Power x Influence (7 Houses)
categories.hint: For each House: Power (that House's ships on the main board, +1 if on the Colony) x your Influence (track steps + your Hidden Influence cards of that House). Enter each product.

categories.label: Secret Agendas completed
categories.hint: 6 Prestige each for Personal Agenda and Fleet Agenda met (0-2 agendas).

categories.label: Cadet cards played
categories.hint: 2 Prestige per played Cadet Operation card (unplayed cards in hand score nothing).

categories.label: Frigate cards played
categories.hint: 2 Prestige per played Frigate Operation card.

categories.label: Resources (total)
categories.hint: 1 Prestige per 4 resources, rounded down; resources in corrupted Compartments count.

categories.label: Corruption on Frigate board
categories.hint: -2 Prestige per Corruption on your corrupted Compartments (not Void Residue spaces). Enter the count.

tiebreakers.description: Tied players: the one earlier in turn order wins.

notes: family: area-majority (influence x power) + prestige sources. Verified against the official Dized digital rulebook (Final Scoring page), not the PDF (BGG file returned 403). Hidden Influence cards do not give flat points: each adds 1 Influence to its House, folded into houseInfluence. Final Scoring text is identical in structure for the 4 Cycles; a separate Solo Final Scoring page exists and is not modelled. Dized has two Final Scoring pages (standard vs another edition/mode); the fetched one lists the categories above; cross-check Colony/Admiral edition differences if needed.
